note: Known model-quality findings. The gate fails when a finding appears that is not here, and also when the total changes -- a fixed-then-reintroduced defect is invisible to a membership test alone. History: 18 findings. 2026-10-15 FIXED 4: sedan, delivery-van, garbage-truck and tire were grounded with `glb_uv_tool.mjs ground`, which shifts every vertex on Y so the lowest point sits at 0 -- the templates are placed at y=0 and the placement code passes only x and z, so a model starting below zero sinks into the road. The delivery van sank 1.0 unit (about 6px at the arena camera); the others 0.3 (about 2px, invisible but the same authoring inconsistency). 2026-10-15 EXEMPTED 2: turbine-wheel (spans -0.3..0.3, symmetric about its origin so it can spin on an axle) and magnetic-turbine (a module mounted on the machine). Recorded in the gate as a reasoned list rather than inferred, because the check cannot know intent. OPEN: poly-google-bulldozer rests at y=-1.103 and is already owner-pending for size and licence; 6 off-centre pivots; battery has no UV layer on any primitive; paper-scrap and trash-bag map every vertex to one texel.
